m.i.title: megamesh.sh — server ɗinka, hanyar fitarka.
m.i.description: Megamesh yana maida VPS mafi arha da zaka iya haya zuwa ƙarfafacce na kashin kai WireGuard VPN tare da admin na yanar gizo. An buɗe tashoshi guda uku, SSH da ke bukatar mabudin kawai, fail2ban, TLS ta atomatik, sabuntawa na mako-mako da ake duba lafiyarsu tare da mayar da baya. Script, prompt na AI, ko mai girkawa da danna sau ɗaya. Buɗaɗɗen tushe (open source), MIT.
m.i.og_description: Ƙarfafacce na kashin kai WireGuard VPN akan 1 GB VPS. Script domin sysops, prompt domin wakilai na AI, da mai girkawa na yanar gizo domin sauran mutane. Buɗaɗɗen tushe (open source), MIT.
i.008: VPN naka — IP ɗaya da izinin root ne kawai
i.010: Megamesh yana maida VPS mafi arha da zaka iya haya zuwa ƙarfafacce na kashin kai WireGuard VPN tare da admin na yanar gizo don na'urorinka. An buɗe tashoshi uku, SSH da ke bukatar mabudin kawai, TLS ta atomatik, sabuntawa na mako-mako da ke komawa baya idan an samu matsala. Naka ne, ana iya bincika shi, MIT.
i.015: ~400 MB da ake amfani da shi bayan girka
i.017: ba a adana komai · babu rikodi
i.020: Hayar rami (tunnel), kai mai biyan kuɗi ne. Gudanar da shi, kai ne mai gudanarwa. VPNs na kasuwanci an gina su don aikin sikel, ba don kai ba: hanyar fita ta haɗin gwiwa, manufofin sirri da kake amincewa da su a makance, akwatin da ba za ka taɓa gani ba. Yawancin jagororin self-hosting suna tsaya a “WireGuard yana aiki” su bar ƙofa a buɗe. Megamesh shine sauran aikin — ƙarfafacce ta asali, akan VPS da farashinsa bai kai na kuɗin biyan wata-wata ba.
i.023: Fayil ɗin bash ɗaya da zaka iya karantawa a minti goma, prompt domin AI agent ɗinka, da saitin da ke aiki a sakwar mai nuni — an wallafa su gabaki ɗaya, MIT, an duba su sau biyu ta hanyar samfuran frontier guda uku tare da kowane sakamako da abin da aka yi akai.
i.025: Idempotent, marar shiga tsakani, kowane saitin wani canjin muhalli (environment variable) ne. Sake gudanawa yana kiyaye zaɓukanka.
i.027: PROMPT.md yana ɗauke da manufa, dokokin tsaro da tarkuna shida da muka ci karo da su, don haka agent ɗin yana farawa daga ƙarshe.
i.029: IP, kalmar sirri ta root, domain, imel. Yana canza kalmar sirri ta root zuwa wadda ka zaɓa, yana girka, kuma yana mika bayanin shiga na admin.
i.037: Yanar gizo ta fili tana isa tasha guda uku kacal. Tsarin firewall na asali shine DROP, ba reject ba: scanners suna samun shiru. A ciki, kwantena biyu da saitin mai masauki kaɗan — duka an rubuta su, babu wani mai rikitarwa.
i.040: tcp/22, udp/51820, tcp/443 kuma babu wani abu daban. Babu port 80, babu admin port, babu Docker ports da ke yatsa waje. ICMP ya tsaya ga ping da path-MTU.
i.042: Shiga ta hanyar kalmar sirri tana nan har sai an tabbatar da mukulli yana aiki, sannan ta bace. Kokari sau uku, dakatarwar sa'o'i 24 tana rubanya zuwa kwanaki 30. Yunkuri 76,073 sun koma yan kalilan din adireshi.
i.044: Caddy yana ƙare 443 tare da Let's Encrypt ta hanyar TLS-ALPN — babu port 80 da zai buɗe. HSTS, tsauraran headers, an cire Server header.
i.047: Peers, QR codes, stats, 2FA. Port ɗin UI ba a taɓa buga shi ba; ana ƙirƙirar asusun admin ta atomatik kafin 443 ya zama mai iya samuwa, domin kada kowa ya riga ku shiga wizard ɗin.
i.049: Na mako-mako, tare da binciken lafiya
i.050: topgrade yana ɗauko kunshe-kunshe da hotunan kwantena, yana sake farawa, yana tabbatar rami yana aiki kuma admin yana amsa — ko kuma ya koma hotunan da suka yi aiki. An daure ta SHA-256.
i.052: Admin yana samuwa ne kawai daga ciki
i.053: Umurni ɗaya yana sa shafin admin ya amsa kawai ta hanyar ramin; na waje suna samun 302 zuwa kowace URL da ka zaɓa. Tabbacin shaida suna ci gaba da sabuntawa.
i.056: Babu wizard, babu tambayoyi. Mai girka yana gudanar da matakai biyar iri ɗaya kowane lokaci kuma yana ƙin buɗe ƙofar da ba zai iya tabbatar da zaka iya shiga ba.
i.058: Swap, hostname, modules na kernel da kwantena za su buƙata.
i.060: Cikakken sabunta tsari, Docker daga signed repo, sabuntawa ta yau da kullum na kansa yana kunne.
i.062: Firewall da farko, sannan sshd, fail2ban, sysctl. Kada a taɓa kullewa kafin firewall ya bude.
i.064: wg-easy shi kadai, aka tabbatar da asusun admin, sannan kawai Caddy. Yana rufewa idan aka samu matsala.
i.066: Handshake, tashoshi (ports), sake gwadawa na takardar shaida (certificate), da lokuta (timers). Sannan zai mika maka bayanan shiga (credentials).
i.067: Kokarin shiga SSH da suka gaza da uwar garken ta samu a kwanaki 25 kafin Megamesh — tare da fail2ban yana “aiki” kuma babu jails. Bayan: 'yan adreshin da aka hana, sannan shiru.
i.068: Wani hoton VPS na yau da kullun, ba a taba shi ba<small>tashoshi suna amsa tambayoyi daga intanet</small>
i.069: Akwatin WireGuard da aka bi jagorarsa<small>wg + ssh + web + docker fitar bayanai</small>
i.072: Mene ne wannan ba shi ba.
i.073: VPN na kanka yana sauya wanda zai iya ganin zirga-zirgar bayanan ka ne, ba wai ko akwai wanda zai iya gani ba. Rumbun lambar (repository) yana bayyana abin da aka gwada da abin da ba a gwada ba dalla-dalla.
i.074: Ba sabis na sirri ba ne
i.075: Mai ba ka sabis na VPS yana ganin zirga-zirgar bayanan ka tana barin hanyar sadarwarsa. Megamesh yana boye ka daga Wi-Fi na kafe da mai ba ka intanet (ISP), amma ba daga sammacin kotu ba.
i.076: Ba don amfanin mutane da yawa a lokaci guda ba
i.077: Admin guda daya, na'urorin ku. wg-easy yana goyon bayan abokan hulda (peers) da yawa, amma karfafa tsaron ya dogara ne akan mai sarrafa shi guda daya amintacce.
i.078: Kamfanin tura tsarin ba shi ya gama shi ba
i.079: Yana sauya kalmar sirri ta root amma yana barin SSH akan kalmar sirri har sai wani ya saka mabudi, kuma yana barin 2FA da yanayin VPN-kadai don ka kunna da kanka. Minti ashirin tare da bayanan karfafa tsaro zai kammala shi.
i.080: Ba a gwada shi a ko'ina ba
i.081: CentOS Stream 9 da Ubuntu 24.04 a kan VPS na 1 vCPU / 1 GB an tabbatar da su daga farko har karshe — na biyun ta hanyar kayan tura tsarin kansa. Rocky, Alma da Debian suna amfani da wadancan hanyoyin lambar amma ba a riga a gudanar da su ba.
i.084: Da zarar na'urorin ku suna cikin hanyar sadarwar (tunnel), duk abin da kuke yi yana fitowa ne daga adreshi na uwar garkersu. Wannan shi ne ma'anar — kuma gaskiya ne da sauran mutane za su iya amfani da shi: aboki zai iya saka ka a jerin amintattu (allow-list), akwatuna naka za su iya amince ma, takaita saurin shiga zai iya cire ka. Marubucin yana wallafa nasa, kuma rumbun lambar shi ne tushen gaskiya game da shi.
i.111: Watsa shi ma kariya ne. Kazafi, labaran kanzon kurege, zargin “wani ya shiga manhajar mu” — kowane aiki a intanet yana barin adireshi a cikin log. Bayyana naka a fili, tare da ranar farawa, kuma duk wata alama da ta fito daga wani wuri daban, ta hanyar bayyanawarka ta baya, ba kai ba ne. Shi kadai ba ya tabbatar da rashin laifi, amma yana ba ka dama: sanarwa ta fili, mai kwanan wata, wadda za a iya tabbatarwa da aka yi kafin kowa ya sami dalilin kokanto a kanta.
i.089: Tabbatardig +short A paulfleury.network · dig +short -x 151.243.225.214 — dole su dace
i.090: Yana gano uwar garken ne, ba mutum ba. Ka tabbatar cewa ana buƙatar tantancewa kafin duk abin da ka saka a jerin amintattu (allow-list) — kuma adireshin yana da sauran masu haya kafin ranar farawa; babu abin da ke kafin ranar da ke na marubucin.
i.092: Mai sarrafa shi guda daya, an wallafa shi baki daya.
i.093: Megamesh sigar mutum daya ce ta akwatuna da megastack.sh, kamfanin shawara kan tsaron intanet na marubucin, ke gina ma abokan hulda — an tsara shi aka kuma sarrafa shi da ma'aikacin AI ta SSH, sannan wasu samfura uku suka rushe shi kafin ya fito fili.
i.094: Paul Fleury — French internet entrepreneur in Lisbon, hacking around on the internet since the late 1990s.
i.095: Dukkan labarin — littafin bayanan tura tsari na farko, binciken tsaro, da gyare-gyare — suna cikin rumbun lambar (repository).
i.096: megamesh.sh · MIT · Megamesh kalma ce, megamesh.sh umarni ne
m.d.title: Tura Megamesh a kan VPS dinka · megamesh.sh
m.d.description: Bawa mai tura tsarin IP na VPS naka, kalmar sirri ta root, domain da email. Zai sauya kalmar sirri ta root zuwa wadda ka zaba, ya tura Megamesh kuma ya mika ma hanyar shiga ta admin.
d.008: Abubuwa hudu, sannan ka jira. Mai tura tsarin zai shiga uwar garken ka ta SSH, ya sauya kalmar sirri ta root zuwa wadda ka zaba, ya girka Megamesh daidai yadda nassin fili zai yi, sannan ya dawo tare da bayanan shiga na admin dinka. Babu abin da ka rubuta da za a adana a ko'ina — yana rayuwa ne a wannan shafin da kuma a cikin buƙatun da ke dauke da shi.
d.014: Sabuwar VPS mai CentOS Stream 9 ko Ubuntu 24.04 (dukansu an tabbatar da su tun daga farko har ƙarshe, har ma ta wannan shafi) — Rocky/Alma 9 da Debian 12 na iya aiki amma har yanzu ba a gwada su ba. 1 vCPU da 1 GB na RAM sun wadatar. Kuna buƙatar root ta SSH tare da kalmar sirri, da kuma domain wanda zaku iya gyara DNS ɗinsa.
d.017: Kalmar sirri ta root ta yanzu <small>daga email ko panel na mai ba ku sabar</small>
d.018: Sabuwar kalmar sirri ta root <small style="font-weight:400;color:var(--faint)">· an ba da shawarar amfani da ita</small>
d.019: Wadda mai samar da sabar ya tura muku ta riga ta bi ta email. Mai tura shirin yana sauya ta a kan sabar kafin ya shigar da komai, sannan ya yi amfani da sabuwar daga nan gaba. Adana ta a cikin ma'adana kalmar sirri taku yanzu; za a sake nuna ta a lokacin mika aiki.
d.020: Sabuwar kalmar sirri ta root <small>haruffa 12–128, ba tare da tazara ba — ko ka bari wofi domin rike ta yanzu</small>
d.023: Email ɗinku <small>don sanarwar takardar shaida kawai</small>
d.024: Maƙallin jama'a na SSH ɗinku <small>na zaɓi — idan kuna da shi, yana shiga kuma akwatin ya samu ƙarin tsaro</small>
d.025: Karanta kafin ka danna. An tura kalmar sirri ta root zuwa megamesh.sh ta HTTPS, ana amfani da ita don shiga sabar ku a lokacin shigarwa, sannan a goge ta. Kowane sabunta matsayin aiki yana sake shiga da ita. Ba mu adana kwafi ko bayanan amfani da ita ba. Idan ba ku so, script ɗin yana ba da sakamako iri ɗaya ba tare da mu a tsakiya ba.
d.028: An shiga. Ga abin da mai shigarwa ya samu, da abin da yake shirin yi.
d.029: Na fahimci cewa shigarwa tana daukar mintuna 10–30, cewa kalmata ta sirri ta root tana wucewa ta megamesh.sh a wancan lokacin kuma ba a adana ta, kuma SSH yana ci gaba da kasancewa da kariya ta kalmar sirri har sai an shigar da mukulli.
d.033: Sabunta samfuran kunshi a kan akwati mai 1 vCPU yana ɗaukar lokaci — mintuna 10 zuwa 30 abu ne na yau da kullun. Kuna iya barin wannan shafin a buɗe; shigarwar tana ci gaba a sabar ku koda kun rufe shi, kuma sake buɗe shafin tare da cikakken bayani iri ɗaya zai ci gaba da shi.
d.041: An gama. VPN ɗinku yana shigar.
d.042: Abubuwa uku ne kawai suka rage, duka daga gefenku. Adana bayanan shiga da farko — sau ɗaya kawai za a nuna su.
d.043: Nuna domain ɗinku zuwa sabar. A wurin mai samar da DNS ɗinku (Namecheap, Cloudflare, OVH…), ƙirƙiri A record: host @, value . Cire kowane rikodin parking ko sake turawa a kan suna guda. Caddy a sabar ku riga yana jiran sa kuma zai karɓi takardar shaida da kansa da zarar rikodin ya warware — yawanci a cikin mintuna.
d.044: Shiga. Buɗe (rubuta https://), yi amfani da bayanan admin na saman nan don shiga, sannan ka kunna two-factor authentication a ƙarƙashin account ɗinka. Ƙara na'ura, scan ɗin QR code, sannan ka haɗa.
d.045: Samu aboki gwani ya ƙarasa ƙarfafa tsaro — mintuna ashirin tare da bayanan hardening: shigar da maƙallin SSH sannan ka kashe kalmomin sirri, a zaɓe ka maida shafin admin ya kasance na VPN-only kawai. Dukkan sauran abubuwa (firewall, fail2ban, automatic updates, weekly health-checked upgrades) riga suna aiki.
d.046: Bayanan shiga a kan sabar. Kwafin bayanin shiga na admin yana zaune a /root/megamesh-admin-credentials a kan VPS ɗinka, mai yiwuwa root kaɗai ne zai karanta. Da zarar ka adana komai a cikin ma'adana kalmar sirri, ka cire shi:
d.047: Na adana su — goge kwafin da ke kan sabar
j.lang.title: Zaɓi harshenku
j.lang.note: An fassara shi ta na'ura daga asali na Turanci, wanda shi ne madogara — kalmomin fasaha da terminal suna kasancewa a Turanci. Zaɓinku za a tuna shi a wannan na'ura.
j.lang.empty: Babu harshen da ya dace da wannan. Gwada sunan a Turanci.
j.d.http_unexpected: Mai shigarwa ya dawo da abin da ba a tsammani ba (HTTP {code}).
j.d.err_ip: Shigar da adreshin IPv4 na jama'a na uwar garken, kamar 203.0.113.10.
j.d.err_port: Lambar tashar SSH dole ne ta kasance tsakanin 1–65535.
j.d.err_pw: Ana buƙatar kalmar sirri ta root na yanzu.
j.d.err_newpw: Haruffa 12–128 da za a iya bugawa; babu sarari.
j.d.err_domain: Shigar da cikakken sunan domain, kamar vpn.example.com.
j.d.err_email: Shigar da adreshin imel mai inganci.
j.d.err_pubkey: Layi ɗaya, wanda ya fara da ssh-ed25519 ko ssh-rsa.
j.d.mm_installed: an riga an shigar — sake gudanarwa ba zai kawo matsala ba
j.d.pw_keep: za a bar shi kamar yadda yake
j.d.ssh_key: An shigar da mabuɗinka; shiga ta kalmar sirri za ta kasance har sai ka kashe ta
j.d.ssh_nokey: Shigar da kalmar sirri yana nan (ba a bayar da mabuɗi ba)
j.d.note_unsupported: Na'urar da ba a tallafawa. Mai shigarwa ya san CentOS Stream / Rocky / Alma 9 da Debian / Ubuntu a kan x86_64. Sake shigar da VPS tare da CentOS Stream 9 ko Ubuntu 24.04 daga kwamitin mai ba ka sabis sannan ka sake gwadawa.
j.d.note_finished: Gama shigarwa yana jiran ka. Fayil ɗin shaidar yana nan a uwar garken — maballin da ke ƙasa yana karanta shi kuma yana nuna mika saƙo, ba za a sake shigar da komai ba.
j.d.note_running: An riga ana gudanar da shigarwa a kan wannan uwar garken. Shigarwa zai haɗu da shi maimakon fara wani.
j.d.note_besteffort: Sarin duba iyakar ƙoƙari. CentOS Stream 9 da Ubuntu 24.04 kawai aka tabbatar tun daga farko har ƙarshe; wannan yana ɗaukar hanyar lamba wanda ba a riga an gudanar ba. Wataƙila zai yi aiki — idan ya gaza, log ɗin zai faɗi inda matsalar take.
j.d.note_small: Ƙamin uwar garke. Na ƙasa da 1 GB RAM da ake gani; mai shigarwa yana ƙara swap kafin sabuntawa, wanda shine ainihin abin da aka gina shi dominsa.

j.d.stopped_err: Layi na ƙarshe a sama sun faɗi inda matsalar take. Gyara dalilin (ko sake shigar da VPS) sannan ka sake gudanar da mai tura shirin — mai shigar da shirin yana da ikon gudanarwa sau da yawa ba tare da sake haifar da matsala ba.
